docs.title: AstroCare — Hospital Management System (HMS)
docs.text:
A modern, secure, and cloud-first HMS built to streamline operations, improve clinical workflows, and deliver better patient experiences across single and multi-facility networks.

🚀 Get started — astrocarekenya.com

docs.title: What is AstroCare?
docs.text: AstroCare is the hospital’s digital command center. It brings together patient management, clinical workflows, labs, radiology, pharmacy, billing, HR, inventory and finance — all from a single, easy-to-use web interface. Designed for hospitals that need accuracy, security, and scale.

docs.title: Core capabilities (quick overview)
docs.text:
• Patient Management — unified patient profiles, DHSH-powered cross-facility search, merge & dedupe.
  • Appointments & Queues — fast booking, walk-ins, clinic types, and doctor schedules.
  • Laboratory & Radiology — sample tracking, result entry, LOINC & FHIR support, QC, blood bank.
  • Pharmacy & Inventory — prescription flows, stock control, expiry alerts, purchase orders.
  • Billing & Payments — invoices, cash, insurance workflows, and M-Pesa (STK Push & Paybill) integration.
  • Finance & Reporting — pricing, receivables, supplier payments, P&L and analytics.
  • HR & Payroll — staff bios, attendance, duty rosters, recruitment and payroll.
  • Admin & Multi-Hospital — facility configuration, board communications, backups, audit logs.
  • Security & Compliance — role-based access, 2FA (SMS/email), encryption in transit & at rest, audit trails (Health Act 2017 & DPA 2019).
  • Integrations — Digital Health Superhighway (Kenya), Africa’s Talking (SMS), WHO ICD-11, email, payment gateways, FHIR APIs.

docs.title: Why hospitals choose AstroCare
docs.text:
• Single dashboard for many hospitals — Super Admin manages multiple facilities, policies and consolidated reports.
  • Pre-service payment enforcement — ensures lab and pharmacy services are settled before processing.
  • Standards-first interoperability — LOINC, FHIR and national DHSH compatibility for secure, consented data exchange.
  • Built for compliance — audit trails, encryption, data minimization and patient consent flows (OTP based) for cross-facility access.
  • Operational resilience — backups, monitoring, and role-based escalation notifications.

docs.title: For IT / Hospital Admin (get live)
docs.text:
1. Request an account at: https://astrocarekenya.com/get-started
  2. Create Super Admin and add facility details (name, timezone, branding).
  3. Configure payment (M-Pesa credentials / Paybill), SMTP, and SMS provider (Africa’s Talking).
  4. Load core data: departments, tariffs, services, and staff.
  5. Run the Go-Live checklist (see Getting Started → First-Time Checklist).

docs.title: For Clinicians & Front-line Staff
docs.text:
1. Open your hospital subdomain (example): https://<hospital-shortname>.astrocarekenya.com
  2. Use the global search (/) to find patient, appointment or order.
  3. Start consultations from the Queue, place orders (labs/rad/pharmacy), and sign off results.
  4. Enable 2FA and review your My Schedule dashboard daily.

docs.title: Security & Patient Consent
docs.text:
• Passwords hashed with modern algorithms; 2FA available (SMS or email OTP).
  • Patient consent is required for DHSH cross-facility lookups — an OTP is sent to the patient for approval before data is shared.
  • Encryption: TLS for transport; AES-256 (or equivalent) at rest.
  • Auditability: full logs of who accessed or changed clinical/financial records.

docs.title: Integrations that matter
docs.text:
• Digital Health Superhighway (Kenya) — cross-facility record lookup, eClaims, worker registry.
  • Africa’s Talking — bulk SMS for appointment reminders and result notifications.
  • M-Pesa (Daraja API) — STK Push & Paybill for instant payments.
  • LOINC & FHIR — standardized lab codes and Observation/DiagnosticReport exchange.
  • WHO ICD-11 API — diagnostic coding suggestions.

docs.title: Appointment Management — AstroCare
docs.text: Efficient scheduling is at the heart of patient care. AstroCare offers a modern appointment management system designed to minimize wait times, optimize doctor availability, and provide a seamless experience for both staff and patients.

docs.title: Why Appointments Matter
docs.text: A well-managed appointment system: - Reduces patient waiting time - Improves staff utilization - Enhances patient satisfaction - Prevents scheduling conflicts

docs.title: Booking an Appointment (After Patient Registration)
docs.text: Once a patient is registered, you can book an appointment in just a few clicks.

docs.title: Steps to Book an Appointment
docs.text:
1. Navigate to Appointments → New Booking.
  2. Select the Patient (search by name, ID, or phone number).
  3. Choose the Visit Type:
  4. General Consultation
  5. Dental Clinic
  6. Optician Clinic
  7. Special Clinics
  8. Walk-in (Lab)
  9. Walk-in (Radiology)
  10. Walk-in (Pharmacy)
  11. Assign the Doctor or Provider:
  12. Filter by specialty (e.g., Dentist, Optometrist)
  13. View available slots in real time
  14. Set the Date & Time:
  15. View availability using the calendar or timeline view
  16. Confirm and Save Appointment.

docs.title: Real-Time Doctor Availability
docs.text: AstroCare shows live schedules for each doctor: - Color-coded slots for available, booked, and blocked times - Instant conflict detection (prevents double booking) - Custom scheduling rules (break times, maximum patients per day)

docs.title: Appointment Types Explained
docs.text: Visit Type Description General Consultation Standard outpatient visit with a general doctor Dental Clinic Visit for dental procedures and consultations Optician Clinic Eye checkups and vision care Special Clinics Specialty consultations (e.g., cardiology, pediatrics) Walk-in (Lab) Direct lab test without prior consultation Walk-in (Radiology) Direct imaging (X-ray, CT scan, MRI) Walk-in (Pharmacy) Direct medication dispensing

docs.title: How Doctors View Their Appointments
docs.text:
Doctors have access to My Schedule under their dashboard: - Daily, weekly, or monthly calendar views - Patient details for each booking - Ability to accept, reschedule, or cancel appointments - Integrated notifications: Email & SMS reminders to patients and doctors

Pro Tip: Doctors can also block their availability for meetings, surgeries, or off-days.

docs.title: Managing Reschedules & Cancellations
docs.text:

  • Patients receive automatic SMS/email alerts for changes.
  • Cancellations are logged for audit tracking.

docs.title: Integration with Other Features
docs.text:

  • Notifications: Automatic reminders to reduce no-shows.
  • Reports: Track doctor utilization, appointment trends, and cancellations.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Always verify patient information before booking.
  • Use calendar filters to avoid overlapping appointments.
  • Enable reminder notifications for both doctors and patients.
  • Keep doctor availability updated to prevent conflicts.

docs.title: Billing & Payments — AstroCare
docs.text: AstroCare provides a secure, transparent, and flexible billing system designed for hospitals and clinics. The platform ensures real-time payment processing, supports multiple payment options, and integrates with insurance and mobile money (M-Pesa) for a seamless financial workflow.

docs.title: Core Principles of Billing in AstroCare
docs.text:
• Pre-Payment Policy: Patients must pay for services before receiving them.
  • Example: Lab tests → Payment before sending the patient to the lab.
  • Example: Pharmacy → Payment before dispensing medication.
  • Multiple Payment Methods:
  • Mobile Money (M-Pesa STK Push, Paybill)
  • Cash
  • Insurance Billing (requires configuration)
  • Complete Transparency: Every transaction is logged and auditable.
  • Instant Receipts: Patients receive digital receipts via SMS or email.

docs.title: 1. Adding Services to the Bill
docs.text:
• Navigate to Billing → New Bill.
  • Select Patient (by name, ID, or phone).
  • Add Services or Items:
  • Consultation
  • Lab Tests
  • Radiology
  • Pharmacy
  • Other charges (e.g., Registration)
  • The system automatically calculates total cost and applies insurance or discounts if applicable.

docs.title: a) M-Pesa STK Push
docs.text:
AstroCare integrates with Safaricom M-Pesa API to allow real-time mobile payments. - Select M-Pesa (STK Push) as the payment method. - Enter the patient’s phone number. - The patient receives a pop-up prompt on their phone to enter M-Pesa PIN. - Payment is confirmed instantly, and the system updates the bill as PAID.

Learn more: Safaricom Daraja API Documentation

docs.title: b) M-Pesa Paybill
docs.text:
• Hospitals with a business Paybill number can accept direct payments.
  • The cashier enters the Transaction Code after confirmation.
  • Optionally, AstroCare can auto-reconcile transactions via M-Pesa API.

docs.title: c) Cash Payment
docs.text:
• Cash can be collected at the cashier desk.
  • Always issue a printed or digital receipt.

docs.title: d) Insurance Billing
docs.text:
• Insurance companies must be configured in the Finance Module.
  • Steps:
  • Go to Finance → Insurance Providers.
  • Add the Insurance Company, policy terms, and claim limits.
  • Assign to patients during registration or billing.
  • Insurance claims are tracked for approval and reconciliation.

docs.title: Pre-Service Payment Enforcement
docs.text:
AstroCare enforces payment before service: - Lab → Pay before lab order is sent. - Radiology → Pay before imaging is scheduled. - Pharmacy → Pay before medication is dispensed. - Special Clinics → Pay before consultation starts.

If payment is not made, the service status remains Pending Billing.

docs.title: Transaction Logs & Audit
docs.text: Every payment creates: - A Transaction Log with: - Patient Name - Service Name - Amount - Payment Method - Transaction ID - Date & Time - All logs are accessible under Finance → Transactions for full audit compliance.

docs.title: Refunds & Adjustments
docs.text:
• Refunds are allowed for overpayments or canceled services.
  • Admin users can approve and process refunds via M-Pesa API or cash.
  • All refunds are logged for audit purposes.

docs.title: Reports & Analytics
docs.text:
• Daily collection reports
  • Service-wise revenue
  • Insurance pending claims
  • M-Pesa vs Cash collection trends

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Verify M-Pesa transactions via the integrated API or Safaricom portal.
  • Configure insurance providers before processing insurance patients.
  • Ensure staff training on billing workflows.
  • Use transaction logs to reconcile accounts daily.

docs.title: Finance Management — AstroCare
docs.text:
AstroCare’s Finance Module is a modern, fully-featured financial management system built specifically for hospitals. It enables administrators, accountants, and finance teams to manage cash flow, insurance, payments, expenses, and pricing in a secure, auditable, and user-friendly environment.

Designed for real-world hospital operations, it supports everything from patient billing and insurance management to supplier payments and full financial reporting.

docs.title: 🚀 Key Features Overview
docs.text:
• Patient Billing & Cash Payments
  • Generate invoices for services (consultation, lab, radiology, pharmacy, etc.).
  • Accept cash payments, record receipts, and automatically update patient account balances.

  • Support partial payments or pre-payments for services like lab tests or pharmacy.

  • Insurance Management

  • Define insurance providers, plans, and the services they cover.
  • Record insurance claims and track receivables.
  • Automatic validation of patient insurance eligibility during registration or service booking.

  • Support bulk insurance payment reconciliation.

  • Service Pricing

  • Set and manage prices for all medical services.
  • Configure tiered pricing: outpatient vs inpatient, walk-in, special clinic pricing.

  • Update pricing centrally — changes propagate to all billing screens.

  • Expense & Supplier Management

  • Track operational expenses (utilities, staff reimbursements, equipment maintenance, etc.).
  • Record supplier payments, outstanding balances, and purchase orders.

  • Link expenses to departments for accurate cost reporting.

  • Financial Reports & Analytics

  • Generate daily, weekly, monthly, and annual reports.
  • Track revenue streams by payment method (cash, insurance, M-Pesa, Paybill).
  • Monitor accounts receivable, outstanding insurance claims, and overdue balances.

  • Dashboard visualizations for revenue, expenses, and profitability.

  • Transaction Logs & Auditability

  • Every transaction is logged: who performed it, timestamp, and action details.
  • Helps with audits, regulatory compliance, and internal review.

docs.title: Patient Billing Workflow
docs.text:
1. Service Selection
  2. When a patient visits, select the services they will receive (consultation, lab, radiology, pharmacy).

  3. Each service automatically pulls its price from the Finance → Services Pricing module.

  4. Payment Method

  5. Cash: receive payment at the point of service.
  6. Insurance: verify coverage, submit invoice to insurance provider, and record receivable.

  7. M-Pesa: integrated mobile payment via STK Push or Paybill. Patients can pay before service delivery.

  8. Invoice Generation

  9. Generate professional PDF/print invoices.

  10. Automatic linkage of invoice to patient record, service order, and finance ledger.

  11. Payment Confirmation

  12. Payments are reflected in the patient account and hospital ledger.
  13. Notifications can be sent via email or SMS for receipts.

docs.title: Insurance Management Workflow
docs.text:
• Define insurance providers and their plans.
  • Assign covered services for each plan (consultation, lab panels, radiology, pharmacy items).
  • During patient registration, select insurance provider and plan.
  • When services are rendered, AstroCare automatically:
  • Generates an insurance invoice
  • Flags services not covered
  • Tracks receivables and payment status
  • Reconcile payments when insurance settles claims.

Learn more about insurance setup: AstroCare Insurance Setup Guide

docs.title: Expense & Supplier Payment Management
docs.text:
• Record hospital expenses under categories: Utilities, Staff Allowances, Medical Supplies, Equipment.
  • Track supplier invoices and payments.
  • Link payments to specific services or departments for full cost visibility.
  • Generate cash flow reports to see liabilities and pending payments.

docs.title: Financial Reports
docs.text:
AstroCare generates comprehensive financial analytics for decision-making:

  • Revenue by Department: How much revenue each hospital unit generates.
  • Payments by Method: Cash, insurance, M-Pesa, Paybill.
  • Expense Reports: Daily, weekly, monthly, annual.
  • Profit & Loss Statement: Automatic calculation for management.
  • Insurance Reconciliation Report: Tracks claims submitted vs. settled.

Explore reports in detail: AstroCare Finance Reports

docs.title: Security & Compliance
docs.text:
• Role-based access ensures only authorized finance staff can view or modify financial data.
  • Audit logs track all transactions, invoice edits, and approvals.
  • Compliance with Health Act 2017 and Data Protection Act 2019 for secure handling of patient and financial data.

docs.title: Integration Points
docs.text:
• Billing → Finance: All patient payments flow automatically to finance ledgers.
  • Finance → Inventory: Service costs and lab/medication usage reflected in financial reports.
  • Insurance Systems: Supports electronic claims submission and reconciliation.
  • Payment Gateways: M-Pesa STK Push and Paybill for seamless mobile payments.

docs.title: Recommended Best Practices
docs.text:
• Predefine all services and pricing in Finance before onboarding patients.
  • Reconcile insurance payments regularly to maintain accurate receivables.
  • Ensure audit trails are reviewed periodically.
  • Link departmental expenses to service lines for accurate costing.
  • Always validate M-Pesa / Paybill callbacks before marking invoices as paid.

  • M-Pesa STK Push Integration: https://developer.safaricom.co.ke

AstroCare Finance Module gives hospital administrators and finance teams the control, accuracy, and transparency they need to run a modern, multi-service hospital efficiently.

docs.title: Human Resources (HR) Management — AstroCare
docs.text: AstroCare’s HR Module is your centralized hub to manage hospital staff efficiently. From onboarding new employees to tracking attendance, payroll, and disciplinary actions, this module ensures that staff management is transparent, compliant, and streamlined.

docs.title: 🚀 Key Features Overview
docs.text:
• Staff Profiles & Biographies
  • Maintain detailed staff profiles: name, photo, role, department, qualifications, certifications, and emergency contacts.
  • Track employment history, promotions, and department transfers.

  • Link staff profiles to payroll, attendance, and duties.

  • Attendance & Duty Tracking

  • Record daily attendance automatically via biometric systems or manual entry.
  • Track shifts, on-call schedules, and overtime.

  • Generate attendance reports for payroll and performance review.

  • Payroll Management

  • Automate salary calculation including basic pay, allowances, deductions, and bonuses.
  • Generate payslips and tax forms.
  • Integrates with financial module for real-time accounting and expense tracking.

  • Support multiple pay frequencies: monthly, bi-weekly, or custom cycles.

  • Disciplinary Management

  • Document disciplinary cases, warnings, and resolutions.
  • Track actions taken and generate reports for HR audits.

  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with labor regulations.

  • Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Manage job postings, applications, and interview scheduling.
  • Track recruitment pipeline and hire status.

  • Automatically onboard new employees into HR, payroll, and department systems.

  • Leave & Benefits Management

  • Configure leave types (annual, sick, maternity/paternity, etc.) and approval workflows.
  • Track leave balances, approvals, and history.

  • Manage benefits including health insurance, retirement contributions, and allowances.

  • Performance Management

  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) for staff evaluations.
  • Schedule performance reviews and generate reports.

  • Link outcomes to promotions, salary adjustments, and training needs.

  • Audit & Compliance

  • Complete audit trail for staff management actions.
  • Ensure compliance with labor laws, Health Act 2017, and Kenya Data Protection Act 2019.
  • Export reports for HR compliance and management review.

docs.text:
1. Adding New Staff
  2. Navigate to HR → Add New Staff.
  3. Fill in personal information, role, department, and employment start date.

  4. Assign system roles and connect payroll account.

  5. Recording Attendance

  6. Biometric or manual entry options.

  8. Highlight anomalies or absent staff automatically.

  9. Payroll Processing

  10. Calculate salaries based on attendance and pre-defined rules.
  11. Approve payroll and send electronic payslips.

  12. Integrate with financial module for expense tracking and reporting.

  13. Disciplinary Actions

  14. Document cases including date, staff involved, and actions taken.

  15. Generate summary reports for management review.

  16. Recruitment & Onboarding

  17. Post open positions, manage applications, and track candidate progress.
  18. Onboard new hires directly into HR and payroll systems.

docs.title: Inventory Management — AstroCare
docs.text:
AstroCare’s Inventory Module is the central hub for managing hospital stores and warehouses. It empowers store managers, procurement officers, and department heads to track stock, handle orders, manage suppliers, and maintain full control of medical and non-medical supplies.

The module is designed for accuracy, efficiency, and transparency, ensuring that every item—from medicines to medical equipment—is accounted for and readily available when needed.

docs.title: 🚀 Key Features Overview
docs.text:
• Stock Management
  • Track all items in the store: medication, consumables, medical devices, and assets.
  • Automatic notifications for expiry dates, low stock alerts, and reorder thresholds.

  • View real-time inventory levels per item and department.

  • Order Management

  • Departments can request items through the system.
  • Store managers review, approve, and dispatch requested items.

  • Maintain delivery logs and track orders from request to fulfillment.

  • Supplier Management

  • Add, update, and manage supplier information.
  • Link suppliers to specific categories (medications, lab reagents, medical equipment).

  • Track supplier performance and history of orders.

  • Purchase Orders

  • Create new purchase orders for suppliers.
  • Track pending, approved, and delivered orders.
  • Record invoices and attach supporting documents.

  • Sync orders with financial module for payment tracking.

  • Expiry & Quality Control

  • Monitor expiration dates for medications and consumables.
  • Generate reports of items near expiry and take proactive action.

  • Conduct quality checks and manage defective or returned items.

  • Asset & Equipment Tracking

  • Track usage, maintenance, and location of medical equipment.
  • Schedule routine maintenance and log equipment downtime.

  • Link equipment to relevant departments for accountability.

  • Inventory Reports & Analytics

  • Real-time reports of stock levels, order fulfillment, supplier performance, and asset usage.
  • Exportable reports for auditing and strategic planning.

docs.title: Inventory Workflow
docs.text:
1. Adding Items to Inventory
  2. Navigate to Inventory → Add New Item.
  3. Provide details: Item name, category, supplier, unit price, quantity, expiry date (if applicable), and storage location.

  4. Images can be uploaded for easier identification.

  5. Receiving Orders

  6. Record deliveries from suppliers.
  7. Verify quantity, batch, and expiry before approving stock.

  8. Mark items as available in the system.

  9. Department Requests

  10. Departments submit item requests via the system.
  11. Store manager reviews and approves requests.

  12. Items are delivered to the department with a delivery note.

  13. Stock Monitoring

  14. Automated alerts for low stock, expired items, and nearing expiry.
  15. Track stock movement to prevent discrepancies.

  16. Reports available for daily, weekly, and monthly inventory audit.

  17. Supplier Orders

  18. Create purchase orders for needed items.
  19. Track order status: Pending, Approved, Shipped, Received.
  20. Update inventory automatically once items are received.

docs.text:

  • Ensures transparency and compliance for audits.

docs.title: Recommended Practices
docs.text:
• Regularly update stock levels and expiry dates.
  • Approve orders promptly to avoid delays in patient care.
  • Conduct periodic audits to reconcile physical and system stock.

docs.title: Laboratory Management — Complete Workflow
docs.text: The Laboratory module in AstroCare enables streamlined diagnostic operations across all lab sections. From receiving test requests to generating reports, every step is optimized for accuracy, compliance, and speed.

docs.title: Key Features at a Glance
docs.text:
• Lab Test Order Management — Receive & track test requests from clinicians.
  • Sample Collection & Labeling — Full chain-of-custody.
  • Result Entry & Approval Workflow — Role-based review before release.
  • Rejection Handling — Standardized reasons with audit trail.
  • LOINC & FHIR API Support — Interoperable coding for structured lab data.
  • Dynamic Reference Ranges — Parameter-based limits for interpretation.
  • Blood Bank Management — Track donors, inventory, and transfusions.
  • Quality Control & Maintenance Logs — Compliance-ready operations.
  • Pricing & Billing Integration — Linked to Finance module.
  • Reporting & Analytics — For clinical, operational, and compliance insights.

docs.title: 1. Receiving Lab Test Orders
docs.text:
• Test requests are generated during consultations or added from reception for walk-ins.
  • Orders appear in the Pending Samples list in the Lab Dashboard.
  • Each order contains:
  • Patient details
  • Requested tests or panels
  • Priority (Routine / Urgent / Stat)
  • Payment status (must be cleared before sample collection if configured)

Quick link: Consultation & Orders

docs.title: 2. Sample Collection & Labeling
docs.text:
• Lab staff accept the order, print barcode labels, and attach them to sample containers.
  • Supported sample types: Blood, Urine, Sputum, Swab, Tissue, CSF.
  • Chain-of-custody tracked:
  • Collected by
  • Date & time
  • Location
  • Auto-notify clinicians once sample is collected.

Tip: Use barcode scanners for faster workflow and fewer errors.

docs.title: 3. Sample Rejection Policy
docs.text:
A sample can be rejected if: - Incorrect container or anticoagulant used. - Insufficient volume for analysis. - Hemolyzed or contaminated specimen. - Delay in transport causing sample degradation.

When rejecting: - Select standardized reason for rejection in system. - Notify requesting clinician with instructions for recollection. - All rejection events are logged for quality audits.

docs.title: 4. Performing Tests & Result Entry
docs.text:
• Select the received sample and mark as In Progress.
  • Enter results for each parameter:
  • Example: CBC → Hemoglobin, WBC, Platelets, etc.
  • Attach instrument auto-generated files (PDF, HL7 messages) for traceability.
  • Enter comments or flags for abnormal values.
  • Add reference ranges (auto-suggested from test configuration).
  • Pending results can be saved as drafts before validation.

docs.title: 5. Result Approval Workflow
docs.text:
• Two-level verification is recommended:
  • Technologist → initial entry.
  • Lab Supervisor / Pathologist → approval.
  • Once approved, results are:
  • Auto-attached to the patient’s chart.
  • Available to clinicians for review.
  • Visible in the Patient Portal (if enabled).

docs.title: LOINC & FHIR API Integration
docs.text:
AstroCare supports LOINC codes for standardized test identification and FHIR APIs for interoperability: - Each lab test can be mapped to a LOINC code. - Enables exchange with national health systems and DHSH. - Improves semantic interoperability for analytics & AI-driven care.

Learn more: - LOINC Official Site - FHIR Laboratory Implementation Guide

docs.title: Parameters & Reference Ranges
docs.text: Each lab test in AstroCare has: - Test name & code - Parameters (e.g., Hemoglobin, WBC for CBC) - Reference ranges (age/sex-specific if applicable) - Units of measurement - Critical values (highlighted in red) - Comments & interpretation fields

docs.title: Lab Test Pricing
docs.text:
• Prices are set in the Finance module and linked automatically to billing.
  • Pricing supports:
  • Cash
  • Insurance (configured under Finance → Insurance settings)
  • If the lab test is unpaid (and pre-payment rule is enabled), the order remains in Pending Payment status.

docs.title: Inventory & Test Availability
docs.text:
• If reagents or kits for a test are out of stock:
  • The system automatically disables the test for ordering.
  • Alerts are sent to Inventory & Lab Admin.
  • Integrates with the Inventory module for stock levels and reorder triggers.

Quick link: Inventory Management

docs.title: Blood Bank Management
docs.text:
AstroCare’s Blood Bank feature includes: - Donor Management: - Register donors, track blood group, and screening results. - Component Tracking: - Whole blood, plasma, platelets, cryoprecipitate. - Inventory Monitoring: - Available units, expiry alerts, quarantined stock. - Crossmatching & Issue: - Verify compatibility before transfusion.

Important: Blood screening results (HIV, HBV, HCV, Syphilis) must be recorded for compliance.

docs.title: Quality Control (QC)
docs.text:
• Record daily, weekly, and monthly QC checks for instruments.
  • Document control ranges, corrective actions, and calibration logs.
  • Track external quality assurance (EQA) participation and results.

docs.title: Lab Equipment Maintenance
docs.text:
• Maintain service schedules for analyzers.
  • Log calibration dates, maintenance actions, and breakdowns.
  • Auto-generate maintenance reminders to prevent downtime.

docs.title: Lab Reports & Analytics
docs.text:
• Patient Reports:
  • Print or share digitally (PDF with QR verification).
  • Operational Reports:
  • Pending tests, TAT (Turnaround Time), QC logs.
  • Financial Reports:
  • Revenue per test, insurance claims.
  • Regulatory Reports:
  • Compliance-ready exports (CSV, HL7).

docs.title: Why Approval is Critical
docs.text:
• Prevents release of unverified results.
  • Maintains legal and clinical safety.
  • Ensures audit trail compliance (Health Act 2017, ISO 15189).

docs.title: Patient Management — AstroCare
docs.text: Managing patient records in AstroCare is designed to be simple, secure, and fast. This guide walks you through creating, searching, and maintaining patient records with best practices.

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
AstroCare provides a centralized patient profile for every individual, accessible through the HMS dashboard. Each profile includes demographic details, medical history, visit records, and billing information.

You can also search patients using the Digital Health Superhighway (DHSH) for interoperability across multiple hospitals.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Create new patient profiles quickly with all essential details
  • Advanced search by name, ID, phone, or Digital Health Superhighway ID
  • View complete patient history: visits, diagnoses, prescriptions, lab results
  • Attach documents and images (X-rays, reports, scanned IDs)
  • Secure editing and audit logging for every change
  • Merge duplicate records to maintain clean data

docs.title: Adding a New Patient
docs.text:
1. Go to Patients → Add New in the sidebar.
  2. Enter:
  3. Basic Info: Full name, gender, date of birth, ID/passport
  4. Contact: Phone number, email, address
  5. Emergency Contact: Name and phone
  6. Insurance details (optional)
  7. Upload any supporting documents (e.g., ID, insurance card).
  8. Click Save & Continue.

Quick Tip: Fields marked * are mandatory. Use accurate data to avoid duplicates.

docs.title: Searching for a Patient
docs.text:
Use the search bar at the top of the Patients module to quickly find patients by: - Name or partial name - Phone number - National ID / Passport - Digital Health Superhighway ID (for cross-hospital access)

If connected to DHSH, you can query external hospitals (with consent) to retrieve verified patient records.

docs.title: Viewing & Managing Patient Profile
docs.text:
Click a patient name to open the Patient Dashboard: - Demographics & contacts - Visit history (OPD/IPD) - Lab & radiology reports - Prescriptions & medications - Billing & payment history - Attachments (ID copies, reports, images)

Actions available: - Update patient details (with audit tracking) - Add new visit or appointment - Upload medical documents - Print patient summary or ID card

docs.title: Dealing with Duplicates
docs.text: If duplicates exist: 1. Select the records to merge. 2. Choose the primary record to retain. 3. Merge — all visits and history will combine under the primary profile.

docs.title: Integration with Digital Health Superhighway
docs.text:
AstroCare connects to the DHSH network for inter-hospital patient lookup: - Verify patient identity during referrals. - Access shared medical history (subject to consent). - Improve continuity of care across facilities.

Setup required: Ensure DHSH integration is enabled in Administration → Integrations.

docs.title: Best Practices
docs.text:
• Always confirm patient identity before creating a new record.
  • Use search first to avoid duplicates.
  • Keep contact and insurance info updated.
  • Use secure upload for sensitive documents.
  • Regularly review and clean duplicate data.

docs.title: Security & Compliance — AstroCare
docs.text: AstroCare is built with security and privacy at its core, ensuring that hospital operations, patient records, and sensitive financial data remain safe, compliant, and fully auditable. Our system integrates multiple layers of protection, combining modern encryption, authentication, and regulatory-compliant workflows.

docs.title: 🔐 User Account Security
docs.text:
1. Password Encryption
  2. All user passwords are stored using strong hashing algorithms (e.g., bcrypt/Argon2).

  3. Enforces minimum password strength: length, complexity, and expiration policies.

  4. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)

  5. Users can enable 2FA via SMS OTP or Email OTP.
  6. Protects against account compromise, even if passwords are leaked.

  7. Recommended for super admins, finance, HR, and doctors handling sensitive data.

  8. Session & Device Management

  9. Monitor active sessions per user.
  10. Option to terminate sessions remotely.

  11. Detects suspicious login attempts and geo-anomalies.

  12. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

  13. Fine-grained control: Doctor, Nurse, Lab Tech, Pharmacist, Accountant, HR, Admin, Super Admin.
  14. Each role has strictly limited permissions to prevent unauthorized access.

docs.title: 🏥 Patient Data Security
docs.text:
1. Health Act 2017 & Data Protection Act 2019 Compliance
  2. All patient data is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
  3. Automatic audit trails record every access or modification.

  4. Only authorized personnel can view sensitive data.

  5. Digital Health Superhighway Integration

  6. When accessing patient data across facilities, patient consent is required.
  7. OTP sent to the patient via email or SMS before cross-hospital access is granted.

  8. Full traceability of access requests and patient approvals.

  9. Data Minimization & Anonymization

  10. Sensitive fields are masked when not required (e.g., billing-only reports).
  11. De-identified data is used for analytics and reporting to reduce privacy risk.

docs.title: 🌐 System Security & Infrastructure
docs.text:
1. Network Security
  2. Configured with firewalls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS).
  3. Enforces HTTPS across all endpoints.

  4. DDoS protection and rate limiting to prevent attacks.

  5. Database & Storage Security

  6. Database access is encrypted and restricted to authorized services.
  7. Backup data is encrypted and stored securely.

  8. Automatic replication for disaster recovery.

  9. Application Security

  10. Input validation and sanitization prevent SQL injection, XSS, CSRF attacks.
  11. Security headers (CSP, HSTS) applied to all pages.

  12. Regular security audits and vulnerability scans.

  13. Logging & Monitoring

  14. Centralized logging of all system events.
  15. Real-time monitoring for anomalies and unauthorized access.
  16. Alerts sent to admins and security officers for suspicious activity.

docs.title: 🛡 Security for Integrations
docs.text:
• API Security
  • All internal and external APIs require authentication tokens.
  • Rate-limited to prevent abuse.

  • Endpoints handling patient data require explicit consent checks.

  • Payment & Financial Data

  • M-Pesa, PayBill, and other payment flows are encrypted.
  • PCI-DSS compliance for payment processing.

docs.title: 📌 Best Practices for Users
docs.text:
• Use strong, unique passwords and enable 2FA.
  • Regularly review access logs for your account.
  • Do not share credentials, even with colleagues.
  • Report any suspicious activity immediately.

AstroCare ensures that security is never an afterthought — protecting your hospital, staff, and patients with modern, reliable, and compliant safeguards.

docs.title: Consultation — Clinical Workflow (Consultation Module)
docs.text: This page explains how clinicians (doctors, clinical officers, nurse practitioners) run consultations in AstroCare. The consultation flow is streamlined so clinicians can focus on patient care while the system handles documentation, orders, and follow-up.

docs.title: Quick overview — what happens in a consultation
docs.text:
1. Patient enters the Consultation Queue (from Appointments or Walk-in).
  2. Clinician accepts the patient and opens the Treatment Form.
  3. Complete clinical assessment (SOAP note) and record diagnosis.
  4. Create lab and radiology requests if needed.
  5. Add prescriptions for pharmacy dispensing.
  6. Mark consultation complete — orders are sent and results will link back to the patient record for review.

docs.title: Consultation Queue (How patients arrive)
docs.text:
• Patients are added to the queue from:
  • Booked appointments (appointments module)
  • Reception check-in (walk-ins)
  • Referral intake (from other facilities)
  • Queue features:
  • Sort by arrival time, priority, or appointment type (e.g., emergency, consult, follow-up)
  • Filter by clinic/room/specialty
  • Quick actions: Call patient, View record, Start consultation

Tip: Use the queue filter to focus on a specific clinician, clinic, or visit type.

docs.title: Starting & Managing a Consultation
docs.text:
1. Select patient from the queue and click Start Consultation.
  2. The system opens the Treatment Form pre-filled with demographics and relevant medical history.

docs.title: Treatment Form — typical fields
docs.text:
• Patient demographics (auto-filled)
  • Visit type (General Consultation / Special Clinic / Follow-up)
  • Presenting complaint
  • History of present illness
  • Past medical history & allergies
  • Vital signs (BP, HR, Temp, SpO₂) — manual entry or integrated devices
  • Triage category (if applicable)
  • Attachments (images, referral letters)

Save frequently. AstroCare auto-saves drafts but saving ensures clinical notes are preserved and auditable.

docs.title: Clinical Assessment (SOAP-style)
docs.text:
AstroCare encourages a structured note to improve clarity:

  • S (Subjective): Patient’s own words — complaint, duration, symptoms
  • O (Objective): Exam findings, vitals, labs already available
  • A (Assessment): Working diagnosis (use ICD-10 codes if available)
  • P (Plan): Tests ordered, treatments, prescriptions, follow-up plan

You can add multiple assessments and link them to problem lists for chronic care.

docs.title: Recording Diagnoses & Problem List
docs.text:
• Add one or more diagnoses during the visit.
  • Optionally select standardized codes (ICD-10) for each diagnosis — helps billing, reporting, and referrals.
  • The patient’s Problem List is updated automatically if you mark a diagnosis as chronic.

docs.title: Lab Requests (Order tests during consultation)
docs.text:
• From the treatment form, add lab tests or panels (e.g., CBC, LFTs).
  • Choose priority (routine / urgent) and sample type.
  • The order is assigned a tracking number and printed label if required.
  • Pre-payment enforcement: If your facility requires payment before processing, the system will mark the order as pending payment until cleared.

Quick link: See detailed lab workflow — ../lab.md

docs.title: Radiology Requests
docs.text:
• Order imaging (X-ray, CT, Ultrasound, MRI) from the same form.
  • Add clinical notes for the radiology team (indication, history, relevant prior imaging).
  • Attach physical files (previous reports, images) to help the radiologist.

Tip: For urgent imaging, set request priority to stat and notify radiology via the in-app notification.

Quick link: See radiology workflow — ../radiology.md

docs.title: Prescribing & Medication (Pharmacy integration)
docs.text:
• Create prescriptions directly in the consultation form.
  • Select medication, dose, frequency, duration, and special instructions.
  • The order is sent to Pharmacy where stock is checked and dispensed.
  • Pre-dispensation payment rule: Pharmacy ensures payment is settled before dispensing if configured.

Insurance payments: If the patient is insured, select the insurance provider during billing so claims are recorded. Insurance setup is managed in Finance.

Quick link: Pharmacy details — ../pharmacy.md Image: Medication order UI — https://astrocarekenya.com/assets/images/medication-order.png

docs.title: Review & Results (Post-consultation)
docs.text:
• Lab and radiology results are automatically attached to the patient’s record when available.
  • Clinicians get notified (in-app / SMS / email) when results are ready.
  • To review results:
  • Open patient record → Results tab → Filter by date or test type.
  • Add interpretation, comments, or refer for further care.
  • Results review can trigger follow-up appointments or treatment changes.

Interoperability: If your site is connected to the Digital Health Superhighway, searches can retrieve verified results shared by other facilities (consent-based).

docs.title: Follow-up, Referrals & Care Plan
docs.text:
• Schedule follow-up appointments from within the consultation (quick-create).
  • Create referrals with attached notes and selected relevant files — send electronically if DHSH / external referral integrations are enabled.
  • Maintain a longitudinal Care Plan for chronic patients (diabetes, hypertension, TB).

docs.title: Attachments & Media
docs.text:
• Attach images (wound photos), scanned documents, and prior reports to the visit.
  • File types allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG, DICOM links for large imaging (stored in PACS or linked via Radiology module).

Privacy note: All attachments are stored securely and logged for audit.

docs.title: Audit Trail & Legal Safety
docs.text:
• Every action (create, update, delete) in a consultation is logged with user, timestamp, and IP (where available).
  • Edits are versioned; the original entry remains in the audit log.
  • This supports compliance with Health Act 2017 and Data Protection Act 2019.

docs.title: Shortcuts & Productivity Tips
docs.text:
• Use global search (/) to bring up patient by name/ID quickly.
  • Start a consult directly from the patient profile: Patient → New Visit → Start Consultation.
  • Use templates for common visit types (e.g., antenatal, TB follow-up, chronic care) to speed documentation.
  • Use pinned checklists for procedure safety steps.

docs.title: Best Practices for Clinicians
docs.text:
• Always confirm patient identity before starting (name + DOB or national ID).
  • Document allergies and current medications at the top of the note.
  • Use standardized diagnosis codes for accurate reporting and billing.
  • Attach key images/reports during the encounter to avoid lost information.
  • Schedule follow-ups during the consult to increase compliance.

docs.title: Access & Onboarding 🚪
docs.text:
AstroCare is a web-based Hospital Management System (HMS). There is no software to install for everyday users — hospitals access AstroCare through secure web addresses and a short onboarding process.

Get started now: https://astrocarekenya.com

docs.text:

  • Subdomains allow custom branding, separate data, and a single platform that’s easy to manage.

docs.title: 2. On-premises / Private Cloud (optional)
docs.text:
• For hospitals that require private hosting, we offer deployment guidance and configuration help.
  • On-prem deployments include domain mapping, firewall and network setup, and MPESA callback configuration if needed.

docs.title: 3. Single Sign-On (SSO) & Enterprise Auth
docs.text:
• AstroCare supports SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, and LDAP/AD integration.
  • We recommend SSO for staff to simplify login and centralize access control.

docs.title: Quick start — First-time onboarding (super admin flow)
docs.text:
These are the minimal steps to get your hospital running:

  1. Request an account or sign up Visit https://astrocarekenya.com/get-started (or contact our sales team) to request your organization account.

  2. Create the Super Admin

  3. Complete organization info (name, address, timezone).

  4. Create Super Admin user and enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).

  5. Add your facility(ies)

  6. Add hospital/clinic names, departments, and default settings.

  7. Enable payment methods

  8. Turn on M-Pesa integration (enter MPESA credentials and callback URL).

  9. Optionally enable other gateways.

  10. Invite staff & assign roles

  11. Create accounts or invite staff by email. Assign roles (Doctor, Nurse, Lab Tech, Pharmacist, Accountant, Receptionist, HR).

  12. Set up departments & services

  13. Add Outpatient, Inpatient, Lab, Radiology, Pharmacy and the services you offer (consultations, tests, imaging).

  14. (Optional) Import existing data

  15. Use the Admin import tool to upload patients, tariffs, and historical records via CSV/Excel.

  16. Go-Live checklist

  17. Verify HTTPS and domain routing.
  18. Test M-Pesa payment flow (sandbox and live).
  19. Confirm user roles & access.
  20. Run a pilot day with a small team.
  21. Enable audit logging and backups.

docs.title: Recommended browsers & network settings
docs.text:
• Browsers: Chrome (latest), Edge (Chromium), Firefox (latest). Mobile: Safari, Chrome.
  • Security: TLS 1.2+ (HTTPS enforced).
  • Ports: 443 for web traffic. For on-prem please ensure the MPESA callback URL is reachable from outside if using M-Pesa.

docs.title: General Questions
docs.text:
Q1: What is AstroCare? AstroCare is a web-based Hospital Management System (HMS) designed to manage multiple hospitals, patients, billing, lab services, HR, and more, from a single modern dashboard. Learn more: AstroCare Overview

Q2: How can my hospital access AstroCare? Hospitals can access AstroCare via a secure web URL (SaaS) or private cloud/on-prem deployment. Example: https://<hospital-shortname>.astrocarekenya.com Learn more: Getting Started

Q3: Is training required for staff? Yes, AstroCare provides training guides, workshops, and video tutorials to ensure smooth onboarding.

docs.title: Patient Management
docs.text:
Q1: How do I register a new patient? Navigate to Patients → Add Patient. Fill in demographic details, medical history, and insurance information.

Q2: Can I search patients across hospitals? Yes! AstroCare connects with the Digital Health Superhighway (Kenya) to search patient records securely across participating hospitals.

Q3: How do I update patient information? Click on the patient profile → Edit → Save. Changes are logged automatically for audit purposes.

docs.title: Appointments
docs.text:
Q1: How do I book an appointment? After patient registration, go to Appointments → New Appointment. - Select visit type: General Consultation, Dental Clinic, Optician Clinic, Special Clinics, Walk-in (Lab/Radiology/Pharmacy). - Assign a doctor and preferred date/time.

Q2: How do doctors view their schedules? Doctors access My Schedule in their dashboard. Bookings appear in real-time, with notifications for new appointments.

docs.title: Billing & Payments
docs.text:
Q1: How can patients pay? Patients can pay via: - M-Pesa STK Push / PayBill (pre-service payment is required for Lab, Pharmacy, and Consultations). - Cash at billing counters. - Insurance (must be configured in Finance module).

Q2: Are transactions logged? Yes, all transactions, including payments, refunds, and insurance claims, are securely logged and auditable.

Learn more: Billing & Payments

docs.title: Laboratory & Radiology
docs.text:
Q1: How do lab sample collections work? Samples are registered in the system, linked to patient appointments. Lab staff can approve, reject, or request re-sampling if needed.

Q2: Can I track lab results? Yes. Results are entered, reviewed, and approved, with parameters, reference ranges, and quality control checks. Integration with LOINC FHIR API ensures standardization.

Learn more: Lab Module | Radiology Module

docs.title: Human Resources (HR)
docs.text:
Q1: How is attendance tracked? HR can manage staff clock-ins, duty rosters, leaves, and absences directly in AstroCare.

Q2: Does AstroCare support payroll? Yes, payroll is automated based on attendance, roles, and salary structure. Reports are exportable.

Learn more: HR Module

docs.title: Administration & Super Admin
docs.text:
Q1: What can a hospital admin do? - Manage all department reports and audit logs. - Manage hospital profiles, facilities, and board communications. - Receive notifications for approvals, backups, and resource center updates.

Q2: What can a super admin do? - Manage multiple hospitals from a single dashboard. - Add new hospitals, view consolidated reports, and configure global settings.

Learn more: Admin Module

docs.title: Security & Compliance
docs.text:
Q1: How is patient data protected? - Health Act 2017 and Data Protection Act 2019 compliance. - Role-based access control, encryption in transit and at rest, audit trails, and OTP-based consent for Digital Health Superhighway access.

Q2: How are user accounts secured? - Encrypted passwords, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA via email/SMS OTP), and session management.

Learn more: Security Module

docs.title: Integrations
docs.text:
Q1: What external systems are integrated? - Digital Health Superhighway (patient info, eClaims, worker registry). - LOINC FHIR API for lab tests. - WHO ICD-11 API for diagnostics. - Africa’s Talking Bulk SMS and email notifications.

Learn more: Integrations

docs.title: General Access Issues
docs.text:
Q1: I cannot access AstroCare via my browser. - Ensure you are using a supported browser: Chrome (latest), Edge (Chromium), Firefox (latest). Mobile: Safari/Chrome. - Check the URL format: https://<hospital-shortname>.astrocarekenya.com. - Verify your internet connection and firewall settings. - Clear cache and cookies or try incognito/private mode.

Q2: The page is loading very slowly. - Ensure a stable internet connection (minimum 5 Mbps for optimal performance). - Large reports may take longer to render—try filtering or exporting smaller sets. - Contact IT to check for network or VPN restrictions.

docs.title: Patient & Appointment Issues
docs.text:
Q1: I cannot find a patient in the system. - Make sure the patient is registered correctly. - Use Digital Health Superhighway search if the patient exists in another facility. - Check if the patient status is inactive or archived.

Q2: Appointments are overlapping or missing. - Ensure the doctor’s schedule is correctly configured. - Refresh the dashboard for real-time updates. - Verify time zone settings in Admin → Facility Settings.

docs.title: Billing & Payment Issues
docs.text:
Q1: M-Pesa payment is not completing. - Confirm the MPESA credentials and callback URL are correctly configured in Finance → Payment Methods. - Ensure patient has sufficient balance or network coverage. - Verify that the transaction logs are not showing any duplicate or pending transactions. - Learn more: AstroCare Billing & Payments

Q2: Insurance payments are not recorded. - Confirm the insurance plan is active and mapped to the patient. - Check Finance → Insurance Receivables → Pending Claims. - Review system logs for failed transactions.

docs.title: Laboratory & Radiology Issues
docs.text:
Q1: Lab test results are missing. - Ensure samples were collected and linked to the correct patient. - Check if the results require approval from a lab supervisor. - Confirm that LOINC FHIR API integration is active for standardized test codes. - Rejected samples will appear in Lab → Rejected Samples with reasons.

Q2: Imaging orders are not visible. - Confirm radiology order was submitted in the appointment workflow. - Verify that assigned radiology staff have proper access rights.

docs.title: HR & Staff Management Issues
docs.text:
Q1: Attendance not updating for staff. - Check device/system used for clock-in/out. - Ensure duties and schedules are correctly configured. - Audit logs are available in HR → Attendance → Logs for troubleshooting discrepancies.

Q2: Payroll discrepancies. - Review attendance, roles, and salary rules. - Verify that bonus, deductions, and leave adjustments are correctly entered.

docs.title: Admin & Multi-Hospital Issues
docs.text:
Q1: Reports are missing or incomplete. - Confirm that data is entered and approved in each module. - Use filters and date ranges appropriately. - Super Admin can check consolidated reports across hospitals.

Q2: Notifications are not received. - Ensure notification settings are enabled for your role. - Verify email and SMS integrations are active in Admin → System Settings.

docs.title: Security & Login Issues
docs.text:
Q1: I forgot my password. - Click “Forgot Password” on login page. - Follow the email or SMS OTP link to reset your password. - For security, 2FA will be prompted after reset.

Q2: Cannot access patient records. - Confirm your role has proper permissions. - For Digital Health Superhighway access, patient OTP consent is required.

docs.title: Integrations & Connectivity
docs.text:
Q1: Digital Health Superhighway data not syncing. - Confirm API keys, endpoints, and hospital registration with DHIS. - Check network/firewall rules for secure outbound connections.

Q2: SMS/Email notifications failing. - Check Africa’s Talking API credentials. - Ensure email server integration (SMTP) is configured correctly.

docs.title: System Performance
docs.text:
Q1: Dashboard charts not loading. - Clear browser cache and refresh. - Ensure data range filters are set appropriately. - Large data sets may require shorter date ranges.

Q2: System crashing or slow response. - Verify server resources (CPU, RAM, Disk). - Check database connection and latency. - Contact IT or AstroCare support for server-side diagnostics.
